notes.title: Total restructuring of the game
notes.notes:
Hello ! I intend to completely restructure the game, it will take a long time and will result in a big enough update for you. In return, the game will come out with a more present history and progressing step by step. New worlds, a new main menu and a healthier and more organized structure for both the English and French versions.

For those preferring the English version to therme they will have the game in English from the start, saving them the effort of having to find the button to put the game in English. As for the gameplay, it will change radically ... The game will change radically as long as it is thought to be another game. However, it is the same game with the same concept . Simply that things will be done more slowly and healthily.

A Multiplayer will be in place, where players can compete against up to four or even five players. I will advise celons the stability of the connections and your feedback. A Coop system will also see the day when you will play different characters with their present history.

I will centralize the game mainly on a stylized effect, in order to make the game as light as possible so that as many computers as possible can play it.

A version for Mac will also see the light of day, so it will not only be available for Windows.

For the moment that will be all, I will surely aim for additional objectives by gradually developing the game and relying on your feedback.

notes.title: Log
notes.notes: - Spawn limit of enemies from AI for security for your computer.

notes.title: Change log
notes.notes: - Even bigger GamePlay, new world look and added difficulty. New enemies, the Demons. Much stronger than other enemies ... Enemies can spawn with assault rifles. The player can now switch weapons and use assault rifles. Debug of the escalation system where the character is facing the wrong way. Debug the system to restart the level. Additional translations in English. An apocalyptic atmosphere now present. The player can now use a flashlight already present in their inventory. The enemies are more careful and dangerous. Also more violent and active.

notes.title: New GamePlay
notes.notes:
New GamePlay released and a much bigger world. Also integration of the Twitch functionality! Your viewers can now spawn enemies in the world who will hunt you down! To do this you need to activate the Twitch console.

Erika will be much harder to find and reach. Find all the mechanisms to open its door once you find it.

notes.title: New version of the game in beta
notes.notes:
English : 

Having had many feedback from you and I thank you too! I released a new version of the game in beta. It is obviously not complete, but the first is to offer you new gameplay with the aim of being more enjoyable to play and a new world. Bigger and allowing freedom of movement also more extensive!

Many fixes were also assigned, for example on the escalation system. At this time your character cannot receive any damage, since the main goal is to allow you to test the new gameplay and the movements of your character.
